Motorsports

XX Programme

Register your interest 2027 calendar

Non-stop emotions

For years a small number of clients have been able to enjoy memorable experiences on and off the track.

We’re talking about the XX Programme, launched in 2005, which take extreme and special cars onto the track at private events, the result of the most thorough technological research, overseen and managed by Ferrari engineers who, through ongoing data collection, pave the way for the development of solutions that will then be implemented in Ferrari production vehicles. This highly exclusive programme has witnessed numerous attempts at imitation over the years, although Ferrari’s success and popularity is unparalleled not least as a result of unique events involving clients in special locations or initiatives.

Download the brochure (2023, PDF)

1Calendar

XX Programme 2027

The 2027 season will unfold across a calendar spanning America, Asia and Europe, with events hosted at some of the most iconic circuits on the international motorsport scene.

  • 12 – 14 Mar The Thermal Club In the USUnited States
  • 18 – 19 Mar Laguna Seca In the USUnited States
  • 14 – 16 May Fuji SpeedwayJapan
  • 28 – 30 May ZandvoortNetherlands
  • 30 Jun – 1 Jul Paul RicardFrance
  • TBC MugelloItaly · dates to be confirmed
  • 17 – 19 Sep Spa-FrancorchampsBelgium
  • TBA Ferrari Finali MondialiVenue and dates to be announced

Ferrari’s 2027 announcement

2The cars

The XX cars

Born in 2017

Ferrari FXX-K Evo

In 2017, on the basis of the experience gained on the track, the Ferrari FXX-K Evo was born – a leap forward in terms of innovation and performance, destined for the “XX Programme” research and development project. It is not a car designed for the road, or indeed for other competitions.

Ferrari FXX-K Evo

Engine
V12
Maximum power
1050 cv
Maximum torque
900 Nm
Total displacement
6262 cc

The first hybrid

Ferrari FXX K

The enormous potential of the car captured in numbers: a total of 1050 hp, 860 of which is delivered by the V12 internal combustion engine, with a further 190 provided by the electric motor, with more than 900 Nm total maximum torque.

Ferrari FXX K

3In the US

Georgia · 21 – 23 May 2026

Road Atlanta

Road Atlanta Raceway hosted, from 21 to 23 May, the sixth round of the season for F1 Clienti and the fifth for XX Programme and Sport Prototipi Clienti, the exclusive non-competitive activities that the Maranello-based manufacturer reserves for its clients.

A total of twenty-six models passed through the pit lane: six FXX Evo, five 599XX, thirteen 599XX Evo and two FXX K.

Ferrari’s report from Road Atlanta
